---
id: ask-where-the-person-decides
title: Don't act on assumptions where the person holds the decision; ask for the missing fact first
level: principle
parent:
scope: global
kind: preference
scenarios: [any]
strength: must
trigger: An action is irreversible, shared, or spends the person's money, and their intent is not explicit
status: verified
seen: 7

themes: [consent, autonomy]

**Do:** Name the decision, state what you would do, and wait for a yes before the irreversible step.

**Why:** Each rule below records a correction after the agent pushed, spent or published on its own.
